Product Description:
Showcase whimsical elegance with the Butterfly Circle CZ Gold-Plated Adjustable Ring for Women. This enchanting ring features a sparkling CZ-studded circle adorned with a delicate Butterfly accent, set on a radiant gold-plated band. Perfect for nature lovers and style seekers, the Butterfly Circle CZ Gold-Plated Adjustable Ring for Women adds a magical yet sophisticated touch to every look, whether for daily flair or special gifting.
Why You Will Love It:
✨ Unique Butterfly and circle design brings fresh, modern style
✨ Sparkling CZ stones add luxury and shimmer
✨ Adjustable fit for all-day comfort and versatility
✨ Perfect for everyday elegance, parties, or gifting
Highlights / Specifications:
🔹 Material: High-quality, sturdy alloy
🔹 Plating: Lush gold plating for lasting radiance
🔹 Stone Type: Brilliant pavé-set cubic zirconia
🔹 Design: Nature-inspired circle ring with leaf accent
🔹 Size/Fit: Adjustable for most finger sizes
🔹 Best Use: Ideal for daily wear, party wear, and thoughtful gifting
Care Instructions:
💎 Clean gently with a microfiber or polishing cloth
🚫 Avoid chemicals, water, and ultrasonic cleaners
🛑 Remove while swimming, showering, or gardening
🌡️ Store in a cool, dry place away from extreme temperatures
Perfect For:
🎁 Gifting on Weddings, Birthdays, Valentine's Day, Festivals
👭 Teen girls, daughters, sisters, and fashion-forward women
💃 Matching with western and ethnic outfits for a glam touch
